desc: Spin Dash (#51) cut short with the stick held, as a player does, in Rogueport's plaza (no enemies): by the hammer, by the partner's move (Goombella's Tattle, read through) and by the Start menu late in the spin's slowing; after each Mario is his own again at once and runs on as the stick asks (the hammer and the partner's move were taken for a script's walk and left him in the spin's forced run, frozen in the run's pose for over a second; the Start menu late in the slowing left him crawling on at a tenth of the run)
log_must: \[spin\] Mario's spin ends \(a scene or a battle\): \d+ units in 4\d frames, at \([^)]*\), then runs
\[input\] where: map 'gor_01', Mario at -?\d+ 0 \d+, .*control 1, .*motion 2, pose M_R_1
